name: Cluster and lensing (red sequence, members, arcs, overdensity)
description: Red sequence from the colour-magnitude diagram (likelihood fit with a tilted sequence), statistical + colour + redshift cluster membership, strong-lensing arc candidates (length/width, curvature radius, tangential alignment) and Poisson-significance overdensity maps.

params.name: mag-column
params.label: Magnitude column
params.help: Magnitude used on the CMD x axis and for the density sample (a catalog column).

params.name: blue-column
params.label: Colour: blue-band magnitude
params.help: Colour = blue - red. Any two magnitude columns (use the band mapping of Photo-z / SED codes for the band names).

params.name: blue-err-column
params.label: Blue magnitude error column
params.help: Empty = only the error floor below.

params.name: min-color-err
params.label: Colour error floor (mag)
params.help: Added in quadrature to the catalog errors.

params.name: center-mode
params.label: Cluster centre
params.help: auto = peak of the galaxy density map (or the centre found by an earlier cluster step); manual = the pixel below.

params.name: center-x
params.label: Centre X (pixel, 1-based)
params.help: Used with manual.

params.name: smooth-px
params.label: Centre-finder smoothing (px, 0 = auto)
params.help: Gaussian sigma of the density map used to find the centre (0 = 3 % of the smaller image side).

params.name: mag-min
params.label: Bright magnitude limit (0 = auto)
params.help: Both limits 0 = 3rd to 85th percentile of the magnitudes.

params.name: mag-ref
params.label: Reference magnitude m0 (0 = median)
params.help: The sequence is colour = a + b (m - m0); a is the colour at m0.

params.name: fit-radius
params.label: Fit radius (px, 0 = auto)
params.help: Only objects closer than this to the centre enter the fit (cluster-dominated region; auto = 12 % of the smaller image side).

params.name: fixed-slope
params.label: Fixed slope (flat sequence)
params.help: Fit a horizontal sequence instead of a tilted one.

params.name: slope-min
params.label: Slope search: minimum
params.help: Range of slopes tried for the starting point.

params.name: rs-window
params.label: Colour window (mag)
params.help: Half width of the colour window around the starting line used by the likelihood fit.

params.name: rs-nsig
params.label: Membership clip (sigma)
params.help: An object is on the sequence when |colour - line| < this x sqrt(scatter^2 + error^2).

params.name: z-column
params.label: Redshift column (empty = none)
params.help: Spectroscopic or photometric redshift column (e.g. EZ_Z or Z_SPEC); objects without a value are not rejected.

params.name: z-center
params.label: Cluster redshift (0 = median of the sequence)

params.name: z-width
params.label: Redshift window dz/(1+z)
params.help: Accept |z - zc| < width (1 + zc).

params.name: pmem-min
params.label: Minimum membership probability
params.help: p_mem = 1 - S_bg / S(r) from the radial profile of the sequence galaxies.

params.name: arc-nsig
params.label: Arc threshold (sigma of smoothed image)
params.help: Region = connected pixels above this x sigma of the Gaussian-smoothed image.

params.name: arc-elong-min
params.label: Pre-filter: minimum A/B
params.help: Only catalog objects at least this elongated are measured.

params.name: arc-lw-min
params.label: Minimum length/width
params.help: Candidate cut on L/W (L = sqrt(12) x rms along the ridge, W = FWHM across).

params.name: arc-align-max
params.label: Maximum tangential misalignment (deg)
params.help: Angle between the major axis and the tangential direction about the centre (needs a centre).

params.name: arc-cc-max
params.label: Maximum centre offset / radius
params.help: Distance of the fitted circle centre from the cluster centre in units of the circle radius.

params.name: arc-allow-straight
params.label: Allow straight (uncurved) candidates
params.help: Default requires curvature: straight tangential edge-on galaxies are then rejected.

params.name: arc-max-cutout
params.label: Maximum cutout half size (px)
params.help: Cutout half size is 4 A + 10, limited by this.

params.name: dens-sample
params.label: Density sample
params.help: all = every object in the magnitude range; rs / members need the red-sequence step first.

params.name: dens-sigma
params.label: Smoothing sigma (px, 0 = auto)
params.help: 0 = 3 % of the smaller image side.

params.name: show-frames
params.label: Open the significance map in a frame
